band-formats.answer: 2002 Format 8 (program-pointer-assignment) is 2023 Format 9, both 'SET { identifier-7 } … TO identifier-8' (§2002:14.8.35.1, §2023:14.9.39.2); 2023's new Format 8 is the function-pointer format on identifier-12/identifier-13, which this rule does not name, and §2002:14.8.35.2 SR20 equals §2023:14.9.39.3 SR21. Same format reached; no change.
